def: Decide which ratio is bigger, smaller, or the same.
defEs: Decidir cuál razón es mayor, menor o igual.
alt: Illustration of Compare Ratios: Decide which ratio is bigger, smaller, or the same.

def: The amount for just 1 of something.
defEs: La cantidad para solo 1 de algo.
alt: Illustration of Unit rate: The amount for just 1 of something.

def: Ratios that compare in the same way.
defEs: Razones que comparan de la misma manera.
alt: Illustration of Equivalent ratio: Ratios that compare in the same way.

def: Look at two amounts. See which is more, less, or the same.
defEs: Mirar dos cantidades para ver cuál es mayor, menor o igual.
alt: Illustration of Compare: Look at two amounts. See which is more, less, or the same.

def: Write it in a smaller form with the same value.
defEs: Escribirlo de forma más corta con el mismo valor.
alt: Illustration of Simplify: Write it in a smaller form with the same value.

def: A bottom number that two fractions share.
defEs: Un número de abajo que comparten dos fracciones.
alt: Illustration of Common denominator: A bottom number that two fractions share.

def: A number you reach when counting by each number.
defEs: Un número al que llegas contando de a saltos con cada número.
alt: Illustration of Common multiple: A number you reach when counting by each number.

def: The smallest number both numbers count up to.
defEs: El número más pequeño al que llegan ambos al contar.
alt: Illustration of Least common multiple: The smallest number both numbers count up to.

def: An amount you change both choices to, so you can compare.
defEs: Una cantidad a la que cambias ambas opciones para compararlas.
alt: Illustration of Benchmark: An amount you change both choices to, so you can compare.
